skill.summary: Detect and diagnose memory leaks in applications. Analyze heap snapshots, track memory growth over time, identify leaked objects (event listeners, closures,...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of memory-leak-hunter — a tool for detecting and diagnosing application memory leaks.

- Analyze heap growth, compare snapshots, and reveal retained/leaked objects (event listeners, closures, timers, detached DOM nodes, unclosed connections)
- Step-by-step commands for detecting leaks in Node.js, Python, and containerized environments
- Search and diagnose common leak patterns in codebases
- Generate actionable reports identifying root causes and suggested fixes
- Support for continuous memory profiling and alerting
- Provide targeted remediation strategies for frequent memory leak issues
